headline: Day before FOMC: leading indicators (dollar strength, financials into a 50% short, VIX long) point to indices weakness — overnight ran to the 30-handle; watch counter-trend squeezes to Monday's highs.
market_state: 1 day before FOMC. Econ: ADP 8:15, goods trade 8:30, CB consumer confidence + Richmond mfg 10:00. Fed-watch: ~2 hikes priced into 2026 (Sept 35.8 from 37.9; Dec still winning) — debatable even one is priced re: indices. Regime = INFLATIONARY BOOM (economy + prices rising) -> rotate to real assets (gold/commodities/energy); bonds weak. Dollar-correlation still negative on indices; crude turned positive; gold/silver negative-correlation fading toward neutral.
bias: BEARISH continuation favored: dollar strength, financials into a 50% retracement short, and a VIX long all point to indices weakness (overnight ran to the 30-handle). Watch counter-trend hedge-covering SQUEEZES up to Monday's highs (~7050 = 50% short) if the dollar AND VIX break their week lows->highs longs.

es.current_mm: 3-week pattern: Monday-high squeeze -> sell off -> 50% shorts (last week hit targets; this week's not yet, target down at 7359). Straight-down series vs retests is decided by whether the dollar/VIX hold their longs.
es.trend: Downtrend; counter-trends are against it. Range top = 7050 (50% short). Overnight showed real weakness (ran to 30-handle, bounced).

key_levels.label: This week's short target (not yet hit)

es.watch: Below the 30-handle at the open = markets falling apart (pro gap-and-go down). Counter-trend squeezes only appear if the dollar & VIX lose their week lows->highs longs -> revisit Monday lows -> ES squeezes to Monday highs.

ES.notes: counter-trend squeezes are against the trend

NQ.notes: extra afternoon highs->lows = more protection than ES

YM.notes: flight-to-quality rotation into the Dow; least desirable short

scenarios.thesis: Weakness continuation: dollar/VIX hold longs -> ES straight down in the series.
scenarios.trigger: dollar & VIX hold week longs / open <30-handle
scenarios.invalidation: dollar & VIX lose their week lows->highs longs

scenarios.thesis: Hedge-covering squeeze up to Monday's highs if the leading indicators break.
Bank into a 50% retracement short = financials confirm indices weakness.
Inflationary-boom real-asset rotation; traditional-long 80.27 defends -> extension.
Weakest index, straight down in halfway-back shorts.

key_quotes.text: When the dot drifts into the upper right, it's time to rotate towards real assets — gold, commodities, and energy producers.
Our leading indicators are pointing towards weakness on the indices — the dollar, the financials, the VIX.
We fall below the 30 handle... there's only a 32% probability of filling the gap (pro gap-and-go down).

other_notes: Day before FOMC positioning. VIX bull>1875; DXY downtrend-end for indices at 101.316. Silver first-notice in 3 days (one of the largest delivery months on record) = potential bear trap. USD/JPY bull>163.27 (watching for yen strength = carry unwind).
